tagline: Hear a song. It's in your Music library.
brief: A Mac shortcut that hears a song with Shazam, lifts it from YouTube and drops it into your Music library, tagged like a purchase. The name is a cheeky heist joke, so the mark should grin, not threaten: quick, mischievous, a bit outlaw, and simple enough for a 16 px browser tab.
criteria: Success: the joke lands in half a second, it owes nothing to the real GTA logo, it reads at 16 px, works in one colour, and matches the app's heat-on-ink window.

concepts.name: Swag Note
concepts.idea: The cartoon burglar's loot sack, with a music note where the $ should be.
rationale: One glance: stolen goods, but it's music. That's the whole product
Solid silhouette plus one big cut-out survives 16 px; a merged small-size cut handles favicons
Heat red on getaway ink comes straight from the app's own window palette
Slanted condensed wordmark adds speed without borrowing the GTA box-letter look

recommendation: Swag Note: the fastest joke, the strongest small-size mark, and one that grows into stickers, merch and a mascot-free system.
next_steps: Use brand/icons for the GitHub Pages site or any web page
Set brand/icon/GrandTheftAudio.icns on the shortcut's app or folder if you ship one
Run a trademark search before any public launch (the name parodies GTA)
